note: FHN, which includes Freeport Memorial Hospital, became part of Mercyhealth on January 1, 2026 ({source}). The figures on this page come from FHN's own filing for the fiscal year ending December 2024, before the merger, under the chief executive at that time.

FHN (Freeport Memorial Hospital, Freeport, Ill.) joined Mercyhealth on January 1, 2026 ({source}). Its figures are not included here because this filing (fiscal year ending June 2025) predates the merger. FHN appears on [its own page](ein:36-2181997).

The hospital's own filing ({source}) says that $4,348,823 of its bad debt, attributed to patients eligible for financial assistance, "is comprised of the dollar value of the discounts made available to patients under the hospital financial assistance policy" and other uncompensated care. IRS rules do not count bad debt as charity care, and bad debt is stated at charges, not cost. The charity care figure on this page is line 7a as the hospital filed it.
source: St. John's Riverside Hospital, Form 990 Schedule H, Part III line 3, fiscal year ending Dec 2024

note: The hospital's own filing ({source}) says every uninsured patient first receives a 53% discount, and for patients below 200% of the federal poverty guidelines the remaining balance is then "recorded as charity care." The filing does not say whether the 53% discount for those patients is included in its charity care. The figure on this page is line 7a as the hospital filed it.
source: Thorek Memorial Hospital, Form 990 Schedule H, Part III line 9b, fiscal year ending June 2025

note: The filings of both hospitals in this system ({source}; Chatuge Regional's filing uses the same words) say that patients approved for "indigent care (100% write off)" are handled separately from patients approved for "charity care (reduced charge)," and do not say whether the charity care figure (Schedule H line 7a) includes both. Neither filing reports any amount on the other Schedule H lines where such care could appear (7c and 7g). The figure on this page is line 7a as the hospitals filed it.
source: Union County Hospital Authority, Form 990 Schedule H, Part III line 9b, fiscal year ending April 2025
